model_description: Candidate007 retains Candidate006's frozen learned experts through 64-bit moduli. Raw operand bits are fed MSB-first on a fixed feedback-free schedule; the trained transitions learn both reductions and the product. Unsupported inputs use a constant fallback.
training_description: No parameters were changed. Candidate006's experts are copied byte-for-byte. A separately evaluated 25-update reducer continuation was rejected on runtime and is not included in this artifact.
